description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Door Latch Spacers AND Striker Plates
These allow you to adjust your door correctly.
Sometimes it takes 2 spacers per side to correctly set the door, so this kit has enough for the correct spacing.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Spacers, Door Latch
Qty 2 – Striker Plates
qty 4 – Attachment Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
